svg.title: Encoder and decoder SWA bounded replay
svg.desc: Left: on a prefix hit, replay at most the last 128 prefix tokens with the cached main KV and index keys unchanged, rebuild request-owned window KV, then prefill the suffix and decode. Right: layers 0–20 process the full prefill; layers 21–39 process only its final 128 tokens, reusing layer 20's compressed KV and index state. Both omit local history before the replay tail. Token widths are schematic.

g.text: (a) Encoder: reconstruct on a cache hit
